339-677-2438-8201.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

151-3301-5261.easyPrerequisites:
To Arms! is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
151-3301-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
151-3301-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of To Arms! without paying its mana cost.
Resolve To Arms!, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

1339-2425-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2425-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Smothering Abomination triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.

1479-2841-5671-8100.easyPrerequisites:
(optional)You control an Elf or have an Elf card in hand. Your life total is 2 or higher.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Elven Passage.
1479-2841-5671-8100.description:
Fetch a land using Elven Passage.
When the fetched land enters, The Necrobloom and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and The Necrobloom trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

5011-5326-6495.notablePrerequisites:
Cavalier of Night in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
5011-5326-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When The Master enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, doing nothing.
Repeat.
5011-5326-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

222-527-3899-5295.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-5295.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

3234-3293-5411-8095.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5411-8095.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5411-8095.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

648-1880-5087--147.manaNeeded: {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the kicker spell kicked
648-1880-5087--147.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to leave the battlefield.
648-1880-5087--147.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Cause the Fractal to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters onto itself equal to the number the Fractal had.
At the beginning of combat, The Ozolith triggers, moving its counters from itself to Hallar.
Cast any kicker or multikicker spell with kicker by paying its mana cost plus its kicker cost.
Hallar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, then dealing damage equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it to each opponent.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1251-1991-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1251-1991-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

261-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-4186-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2921-6972-7607.easyPrerequisites: There are at least one land card in all graveyards
2921-6972-7607.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Centaur Vinecrasher.
When Centaur Vinecrasher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7235.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Stag Beetle.
When Stag Beetle dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

3490-4659-6822-7256.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
3490-4659-6822-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Warhost's Frenzy triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3963-5902-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3963-5902-7009.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
3963-5902-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage using Meneldor. Meneldor triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Innkeeper's Talent.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

4050-4740-6742.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher, plus an additional 2 life if you cast Timeline Culler using its warp ability.
4050-4740-6742.description:
Cast Timeline Culler from your hand by paying {B}{B} or from your graveyard or hand for its warp cost by paying {B} and 2 life.
Aetherflux Reservoir, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast this turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Timeline Culler, adding {B}.
Repeat.
4050-4740-6742.notes: The amount of life and mana you need to start the combo varies based on how many spells you've cast this turn and where Timeline Culler starts. The life pre-requisite assumes you've cast no spells this turn. If you start by casting Timeline Culler using its warp ability, the starting mana will be {B} instead. Once you have infinite life, you can activate Aetherflux Reservoir to deal damage.

3560-3967-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat from step 3.

339-677-4785-5231.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

997-2086-6824.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Kitchen Finks.
When Kitchen Finks dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Kitchen Finks from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Kitchen Finks enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kitchen Finks.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

261-560-2034-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
261-560-2034-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

2530-2577-2999-6518.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-2999-6518.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Impassioned Orator trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

643-3951-4365-5703.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
643-3951-4365-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-2105-6591--85.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
413-2105-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Combat Celebrant enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat each combat phase.

1339-2034-2122-5902.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2034-2122-5902.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1954-5195-6259.description:
Cast Change of Heart with buyback by paying {W}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Change of Heart.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

64-1987-2239-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
64-1987-2239-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and Warden of the Eye.
When Ardent Elementalist and Warden of the Eye enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-2239-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2060-2713-4029-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-2713-4029-5140.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

413-708-1469-2459.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Court of Vantress trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Court of Vantress.
When Rograkh enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

3604-3698-5365.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue token.
3604-3698-5365.description:
Cast Lonis by paying {1}{G/U}{G/U}.
When Lonis enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Lonis.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing a Clue.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
When the Clue enters the battlefield, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.
3604-3698-5365.notes: You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.

3129-4050-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Cats, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

791-3231-3693-6093.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3231-3693-6093.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

3197-4321-6010.notablePrerequisites:
Builder's Talent is at least level 2.
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
3197-4321-6010.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token and a Food token.
When the Food token enters the battlefield, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 2.

121-2067-4196.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Court of Embereth triggers.
Holding priority, cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Resolve the Court of Embereth trigger, creating a 3/1 Knight creature token, then dealing damage to each opponent equal to the number of creatures you control.
Each opponent whose life total is less than or equal to the number of creatures you control loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1335-2127-4050-4153.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2127-4050-4153.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Elemental creature token.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Tribute to the World Tree triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Elemental.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Elemental, adding {1}.
When the Elemental dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Marath.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite +1/+1 counters on Marath, you may put the +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.

2067-2542-3469.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least thirty, minus one for each poison counter your opponents have and for each creature you control.
2067-2542-3469.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, creating a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
Cast Energy Arc by paying {W}{U}, targeting every creature you control.
Venerated Rotpriest triggers for each creature targeted by Energy Arc.
Resolve the first trigger, causing an opponent to get a poison counter.
Repeat step 4 until an opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters, then repeat for each other opponent.

1068-3258.manaNeeded: {11}{U}{U} your first turn, with {6}{U}{U} available each other turn
1068-3258.description:
Cast Leveler by paying {5}.
When Leveler enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Beacon of Tomorrows during your draw step.
Repeat from step 3.

905-2429-4073.description:
Activate Retribution of the Ancients by paying {B} and removing zero counters from creatures you control, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
Horobi triggers, destroying that creature.
When the creature dies, Revel in Riches' first ability triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

757-2752-4235.notablePrerequisites: Elder Duid does not have summoning sickness.
757-2752-4235.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by tapping it and paying {U}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Elder Duid by paying {3}{G} and tapping it, targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; pay {2} and copy the Magosi ability.
Resolve both copies of the ability, cancelling out your skipped turn and taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Repeat each turn.
